snippets.brief: keep it brief: bullet points, focus on the why, no preamble
snippets.fix: identify the root cause, explain it, then provide the fix with a brief justification
snippets.kiss: keep it simple: pick the most straightforward approach, we can improve later if needed
snippets.pat: look at how similar things are already done in this codebase and follow that pattern
snippets.sand: this is a sandbox issue that shouldn't be there, stop the current task and focus only on adjusting the sandbox
snippets.tdd: use red/green TDD: write a failing test first, then the minimal code to make it pass, then refactor
